products.image: https://classic.cdn.media.amplience.net/i/hibbett/2304K_0256_main/adidas Originals Handball Spezial "Grey One/Grey One/Grey Two" Grade School Boys' Shoe-0256?$large$
products.description:
The adidas Originals Handball Spezial Grade School Boys' "Grey One/Grey One/Grey Two" Shoe have been holding down their place in adidas history since the '70s. First built for pros on the handball court, they're now a must-have pair for sneaker collectors everywhere. This edition comes in a juniors' size range, and it's made with the classic T-toe design and a rubber outsole. A nylon and suede upper rounds out the look.
  • Regular fit
  • Lace closure
  • Leather and textile upper
  • Synthetic
